title: PeaCE-Pea_Pangenome: analysis code for the 85-genome pea (Pisum) pangenome
description: Custom scripts for the manuscript Pea pangenomics connects structural variation with disease. The archive contains six modules: (1) short-read SNP calling, filtering, imputation and PCA; (2) full-length LTR retrotransposon identification (DANTE_LTR + EDTA) and insertion-age estimation; (3) pan-RGAome core/shell/cloud classification and saturation analysis; (4) structural-variant calling from PacBio HiFi reads mapped to CDC Amarillo (Sniffles2 + SVIM) and pan-SV catalogue; (5) transposon insertion polymorphism (TIP) discovery, lineage classification, LTR dating and force-calling; (6) powdery mildew RNA-seq (STAR/RSEM, DESeq2) and Er3 candidate-gene summary. See README.md for usage, inputs, outputs and the figure each script produces.
